reference_answer: The researchers carried out a survey of commuting habits. Specifically, the initial fault set off a chain reaction in the system. These concrete observations clarify the operational scope of the method without overstating its generality.
acceptable_alternatives: Rather than relying on unverified claims, the analysis specifies concrete procedures: The researchers carried out a survey of commuting habits. Meanwhile, the initial fault set off a chain reaction in the system.
explanation_zh:
本题考查【根治只有夸张而无实例/指标的写作病灶（Rule G033/G028）】。
地道学术写作从不说 *extremely great / solves all problems*，而是用具体操作与边界说话：
- 第 1 句用“carry out”（The researchers carried out a survey of commuting habits.）给出具体研究事实或操作定义；
- 第 2 句用“chain reaction”（The initial fault set off a chain reaction in the system.）补充具体测量、分布或样本条件；
- 第 3 句收束于受控范围，实现“主张—具体机制—实证边界”的严密闭环。
